name: Knob & Servo
summary: A potentiometer turning a servo on an Arduino Mega 2560, with calibration and the option to drive the servo from the website instead.
hardware: Potentiometer - outer legs to 5V and GND, middle leg (wiper) to A0
Servo - signal to pin 9, red to 5V, brown to GND
notes: Mega 2560, so flash.ps1 uses fqbn arduino:avr:mega:cpu=atmega2560 and the 'wiring' programmer rather than 'arduino'. The pot reading is smoothed and a 2-degree deadband stops the servo buzzing on ADC noise.
